entities.summary: Viktor Ivanovich Sarianidi or Victor Sarigiannides was a Soviet archaeologist. He discovered the remains of a Bronze Age culture in the Karakum Desert in 1976. The culture came to be known as the Bactria-Margiana Archaeological Complex.
